cast_duration.description: Time in seconds for the entire event sending process

cooldown_time.description: Time in seconds the mob has to wait before using this spell again

do_casting.description: If true, the mob will show a casting animation while sending the event

filters.description: Conditions that the target must meet to be eligible for receiving the event

look_at_target.description: If true, the mob will face the entity it sends an event to

max_activation_range.description: Maximum distance in blocks the target can be for this spell to activate

min_activation_range.description: Minimum distance in blocks the target must be for this spell to activate

particle_color.description: The color of the particles spawned while casting this spell

start_sound_event.description: The sound event to play when this spell starts

weight.description: Relative weight of this spell choice when randomly selected from valid choices
